steps.title: Diagnose Crash Cause
steps.description: Identified integer overflow in timestamp calculation causing negative array index in mascot rendering, unsupported third-party dependency in build.gradle, and audio thread concurrency in SoundManager.

steps.title: Clean Build Script Dependencies
steps.description: Purge non-standard third-party library nanohttpd from build.gradle to ensure 100% native Android SDK compliance.

steps.title: Update Application Manifest & Theme
steps.description: Enforce standard Material.Light theme and window titlebar suppression in manifest and activity lifecycle.

steps.title: Fix Audio Synthesizer Stability
steps.description: Update SoundManager with robust Throwable handling, universal GSM/LTE tone presets, and non-blocking asynchronous audio calls.

steps.title: Fix Array Index Crash in LCD View
steps.description: Correct mascot animation frame computation to strictly produce 0 or 1 using bitwise masking, preventing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

steps.title: Harden Main Activity Lifecycle
steps.description: Configure titlebar suppression before layout inflation and ensure fail-safe sound initialization on startup.

steps.title: Building Brick Game Classic
steps.description: Compile debug APK using Gradle build tools.
